sentences.en: Can we trust his words if he uses non-official stems?
sentences.zh: 如果他使用非官方的说法，我们能信任他的话吗？

sentences.en: The drug did nothing to stem Yanni's drift into depression.
sentences.zh: 这种药物对抑制雅尼的抑郁情绪毫无作用。

sentences.en: Scientists are fighting to stem the spread of the AIDS virus.
sentences.zh: 科学家们正在努力阻止艾滋病病毒的传播。

senses.zh: 阻止；起源于某事物；逆行
